content: Booking-system architecture pitfalls: concurrency bugs rarely reproduce in dev/staging (need real concurrent traffic, e.g. holiday spikes) so they ship unnoticed; relying on frontend-only availability checks or application-level locks without DB-enforced constraints gives a false sense of safety -- a lock can be held correctly and you still double-book if the invariant isn't also enforced at the data layer (unique constraint/serializable transaction). Strong relational consistency (not eventual/NoSQL) is recommended for the booking table itself.
